from solution import find_tuples
import solution


def test_issue_example_given():
    """Find tuples which have all elements divisible by k."""
    # 6%6==0, 24%6==0, 12%6==0 -> keep; 7%6==1 -> drop; 12%6==0, 18%6==0, 21%6==3 -> drop
    assert find_tuples([(6, 24, 12), (7, 9, 6), (12, 18, 21)], 6) == '[(6, 24, 12)]'


def test_issue_empty_list():
    """Find tuples which have all elements divisible by k."""
    # empty input has nothing to keep -> []
    assert find_tuples([], 5) == '[]'


def test_issue_no_tuple_fully_divisible():
    """Find tuples which have all elements divisible by k."""
    # 1%2==1 -> drop; 3%2==1 -> drop => []
    assert find_tuples([(1,), (3, 5)], 2) == '[]'


def test_issue_all_tuples_fully_divisible():
    """Find tuples which have all elements divisible by k."""
    # 4%2==0, 6%2==0 -> keep; 8%2==0 -> keep => both
    assert find_tuples([(4, 6), (8,)], 2) == '[(4, 6), (8,)]'


def test_issue_partially_divisible_tuple_excluded():
    """Find tuples which have all elements divisible by k."""
    # 6%6==0, 12%6==0, 7%6==1 -> drop because not all divisible
    assert find_tuples([(6, 12, 7)], 6) == '[]'


def test_issue_zero_element_counts_as_divisible():
    """Find tuples which have all elements divisible by k."""
    # 0%3==0, 6%3==0, 9%3==0 -> keep
    assert find_tuples([(0, 6, 9)], 3) == '[(0, 6, 9)]'


def test_issue_k_one_matches_every_tuple():
    """Find tuples which have all elements divisible by k."""
    # 7%1==0, 5%1==0 -> keep; 99%1==0 -> keep => all
    assert find_tuples([(7, 5), (99,)], 1) == '[(7, 5), (99,)]'


def test_issue_multiple_matches_preserve_order():
    """Find tuples which have all elements divisible by k."""
    # 10%5==0, 20%5==0 -> keep; 3%5==3 -> drop; 15%5==0 -> keep
    assert find_tuples([(10, 20), (3, 5), (15,)], 5) == '[(10, 20), (15,)]'


def test_contract_result_is_string():
    """Example shows result is string '[(6, 24, 12)]'."""
    # 2%2==0, 4%2==0 -> would be '[(2, 4)]', here only check str type
    assert isinstance(find_tuples([(2, 4)], 2), str)


def test_contract_function_exposed_with_public_name():
    """Public interface is find_tuples(test_list, K) in solution."""
    assert callable(getattr(solution, "find_tuples", None))
